**What you verified**
State exactly what you confirmed, and how (per CONTRIBUTING.md's ground
rule: no invented Appwrite behavior). Pick the strongest evidence you
have:

- **Source**: a link to the exact file/class in
  [appwrite/appwrite](https://github.com/appwrite/appwrite) (include the
  tag/commit).
- **Live**: what you did against a real Appwrite Cloud or self-hosted
  project, and what you observed (request + response, or a description
  if the response contains anything sensitive).
- **Docs**: a link to the official Appwrite documentation.

See [docs/assurance-boundary.md](../../docs/assurance-boundary.md) for
why this distinction matters to amg specifically.
